direct_effect_records.source_no_agenda: the applicable N7 public majority R1 type records
direct_effect_records.value: D_M(o)=Z_E-(c/m)*beta^2*o for o<=1/m; Z_E-beta*o for 1/m<o<tau_M; 0 for o>=tau_M

total_private_effect_records.operation: translate every exact I_U vector by (1-beta,1-beta)
total_private_effect_records.exact_cells: nu=0: (1-beta,max{Delta_U,0}); 0<nu<=nu_star: none because the no-agenda control is none; nu_star<nu<1 and rho=0: {(u-d_H,u-d_H): u in [max{z_L,d_H},z_H]}; nu_star<nu<1 and nu_off in (0,nu_star]: none because the agenda-private arm is none; nu_star<nu<1 and nu_off in (nu_star,1], plus nu=1: (1-beta,1-beta)
total_private_effect_records.zero_members: at nu=0 the counterfactual high-type coordinate is zero iff Delta_U<=0; in the high-prior rho=0 family the linked member is zero iff u=d_H, possible when d_H>=z_L
total_private_effect_records.none_implication: DeltaT is none whenever T_U is none; Q_U is unaffected by absence of the agenda-private arm

total_private_effect_records.operation: translate every exact I_M vector by (D_M(o_0),D_M(o_1))
total_private_effect_records.exact_cells: inherited source-record products; no general sign

institutional_effect_record.sign_rule: U has the larger agenda effect for theta iff DeltaI^theta>-DeltaD^theta

diagonal_records.causal_status: cross-package contrast, not a one-factor causal effect
diagonal_records.exact_cells: nu=0: (1-beta,1-beta); low positive prior: none; high prior: (Delta_U,1-beta)

diagonal_records.causal_status: cross-package contrast, not a one-factor causal effect
diagonal_records.operation: Q_M^{01}=D_M^{01}-beta*RI_M^{N,R1,01} over applicable complete N7 records
